name: guided-code-review
description: Agent suggestions on Markdown documents, with live inline diffs that stage exactly the lines you approve.

guidedCodeReview.syntaxHighlighting.description: Color inline diff source using installed TextMate grammars and the active theme. Unsupported or expensive files remain plain text.

languageModelTools.name: guidedReview_listSessions
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List the suggestion sessions of this workspace: each session name, its document path, and whether its view is open. The other guidedReview tools take the session name directly.

languageModelTools.name: guidedReview_openSession
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Open a suggestion session for a Markdown document, or start one with a blank document without a path. Joins the existing session of the same document. Returns the session name that the other guidedReview tools take. Read the guided-review skill first. Follow the user's task, present at most 2-3 bullet points at a time, then wait for feedback.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Open a suggestion session for a Markdown document, or a blank document.

path.description: Absolute path to a saved Markdown file. Omit it to start a suggestion session with a blank document.

languageModelTools.name: guidedReview_waitForFeedback
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Wait until the reader asks for new suggestions in the suggestion session, or the timeout ends. Returns the events (requests, accepted and declined suggestions, outdated code blocks), the current suggestions and the document path. After presenting at most 2-3 bullet points, wait for feedback; on timeout, wait again without advancing.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Wait for a request from the suggestion session.

languageModelTools.name: guidedReview_addSuggestions
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Add suggestions to a suggestion session; they appear on top in the given order. Follow the user's task and present at most 2-3 bullet points at a time, then wait for feedback. Each replaces the span from..to, inserts after a quote, or appends to the end without an anchor. All document changes go through suggestions; only the reader accepts them. Returns the new ids and the rejected items with their problems.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Show suggestions in the suggestion session.

replacement.description: Markdown that replaces the span, or is inserted.

kind.description: layout (default) restructures without rewording; edit changes wording and needs from/to.

from.description: Unique plain-text quote where the replaced span starts.

to.description: Plain-text quote where the replaced span ends (inclusive).

after.description: Unique plain-text quote to insert after.

languageModelTools.name: guidedReview_removeSuggestions
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Remove suggestions from a suggestion session by id. An empty session shows OK to the reader.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Remove suggestions from the suggestion session.

languageModelTools.name: guidedReview_listSuggestions
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List the suggestions of a suggestion session, with the problems of each.
languageModelTools.userDescription: List the suggestions in the suggestion session.

languageModelTools.name: guidedReview_captureCodeChanges
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Capture changed lines of files (HEAD against the working tree) as spans for a review-diff code block in the suggestion session document. Without ranges, captures every change that no block in the document shows yet. Ranges use new line numbers ('41-42', '41') or old line numbers of removed lines ('old:40'). Returns block fields (repo, file, spans), shows, and inspection: actual core endpoints, neighboring lines outside the core, and an abbreviated preview of the rendered diff. Check inspection against the intended function boundaries before adding a block; recapture incorrect ranges. Ranges are literal, never expanded to functions. Never stages or edits files; only the reader approves a block to stage its lines.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Capture changed lines for a code block in the suggestion session.

file.description: Absolute path of a file in a Git repository in the workspace.

ranges.description: Literal source line ranges. Read the source first and check returned inspection boundaries; partial functions are allowed but never inferred or expanded.

block.description: Id of a block that this capture replaces; its lines do not count as taken.

scripts.build: node scripts/clean.cjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.webview.json
